media.title: Media
media.description: Upload restaurant and campaign photos in their original format. Files stay in one library; use collections to group them (for example style references) without duplicating uploads.
media.descriptionShort: Upload photos once, then group them into collections without duplicating files.

collections.help: Create a collection to group related photos (for example “Style references”). Select a photo in the grid, then add or remove it from a collection. The same photo can belong to more than one collection.
collections.selectHint: Select a photo to add it to a collection. Use the expand control to view it larger.
collections.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Photos stay in your library; only the grouping is removed.
collections.createFirstHint: Create a collection first, then add this photo.
collections.emptyCollectionDescription: Switch to All, select a photo, then add it here.

upload.title: Upload media
upload.hint: Drag and drop or browse — PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF
upload.hintMobile: Browse your library — PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF

empty.title: No media yet
empty.description: Upload your first file to build your media library.
